chain.title: Something to Wind Onto
chain.desc: Two iron plates around an iron nugget, sixteen at a time. Empty until wire is wound on it, and every electrical block in the mod starts here.

chain.title: Squeezing Metal Thin
chain.desc: Iron plates, a shaft, andesite alloy and andesite casing. Fed rotation it draws ingots into rods and plates into wire; nothing electrical happens without it.

chain.title: Drawn Copper
chain.desc: A copper plate through the rolling mill gives two. Copper conducts best of the cheap metals, which is why the first spool you build is copper.

chain.title: Wound and Ready
chain.desc: Four copper wire around an empty spool. A spool is the coil at the heart of the alternator, the motor and the tesla coil alike.

chain.title: Holding the Charge
chain.desc: A zinc plate, a copper plate and a redstone torch. Buffers energy inside a machine so the motor does not stall the instant supply dips.

chain.title: Rotation Becomes Current
chain.desc: Mechanical crafting: iron plates and rods around copper spools and a capacitor. Spin it and your windmills start paying out Forge Energy.

chain.title: Current Becomes Rotation
chain.desc: The alternator run backwards, built on brass plates instead of iron. Feed it energy and it outputs shaft rotation at a speed you dial in.

chain.title: Where the Wire Lands
chain.desc: A copper rod, andesite alloy and a slimeball, three at a time. Stuck to any energy-capable block it becomes an endpoint you can string wire between.

chain.title: A Switch for Electricity
chain.desc: Two connectors either side of an electron tube on a stone bed. Passes current from input to output only while a redstone signal holds it open.

chain.title: The Bank
chain.desc: Capacitors flanking a brass casing with a copper rod and gold or electrum wire. Stack them into a multiblock and the buffer grows with the tower.

chain.title: Arcs and Consequences
chain.desc: Mechanical crafting from copper spools, capacitors, brass plates, brass casing and an electron tube. Discharges stored energy into whatever stands near it.

chain.title: Charging on the Move
chain.desc: Brass casing, a chute and a copper spool. Paired across a contraption gap it passes energy to a moving train or a rotating platform.

chain.title: Do Not Walk Here
chain.desc: Four iron wire in a ring, two at a time. Cheap area denial that hurts anything crossing it, and it needs no power at all.

chain.title: Zinc Under the Press
chain.desc: One zinc ingot pressed flat. The mod adds plates for metals base Create never bothered to press, and this is the one its own capacitor needs.

chain.title: Crushed Perfection
chain.desc: One diamond through the crushing wheels. The hardest abrasive the pack has, and worth more as grit than it ever was as a gem.

chain.title: The Last Polish
chain.desc: Paper dusted with diamond grit. Outlasts Create's own red sand paper by a wide margin when polishing rose quartz in bulk.

chain.title: Pale Gold
chain.desc: Gold and silver mixed hot in a basin. The mod's own alloy, and the best conductor it offers, so every long wire run wants it.

chain.title: Rolled Pale
chain.desc: An electrum ingot pressed into a plate. The intermediate that becomes electrum wire, which carries more current per strand than copper or gold.

chain.title: Stacked Alloy
chain.desc: Nine electrum ingots. Storage that also reads as a deliberate flourish in a wiring room, since electrum has no other block form.

chain.title: Worn for Luck
chain.desc: Electrum ingots and wire wrapped around an emerald. Purely a trinket, but the mod's one piece of jewellery and a natural milestone.

chain.title: Green Turned Useful
chain.desc: Crops, leaves, saplings, flowers or sticks mixed hot with seed oil. The mod's answer to burning coal: grow your fuel instead of digging it.

notes: Create Crafts and Additions bolts Forge Energy onto Create and assumes the base mod is solved. Base-Create dependencies derived from the recipes: create:andesite_alloy, create:andesite_casing, create:brass_casing, create:shaft, create:chute, create:electron_tube, create:cinder_flour, create:dough, create:chocolate, plus a mechanical press (every forge:plates/* input), crushing wheels (diamond_grit), a heated basin/mixer (biomass and the electrum alloy) and mechanical crafting for the alternator, electric motor and tesla coil. THE HARD GATE: the rolling mill must come before every rod and every wire. All ten createaddition:rolling recipes take the mill, so copper_rod / iron_rod / gold_rod / brass_rod / electrum_rod and copper_wire / iron_wire / gold_wire / electrum_wire and straw are all downstream of it. ORDERING CONFLICTS vs moddb consensus (26 entries, ALL 26 id-verified, no renamed ids): the consensus ordering is broadly impossible on the recipe graph. (1) createaddition:rolling_mill sits at pos 0.286 while iron_rod 0.115, gold_rod 0.154, gold_wire 0.192, electrum_wire 0.231 and copper_wire 0.269 all sit BEFORE it, yet all five are rolling-mill-only outputs. The mill was moved to step 2. (2) createaddition:copper_spool sits at 0.646 but electric_motor 0.346, tesla_coil 0.536 and alternator 0.654 all consume copper spools, and portable_energy_interface 0.676 does too. The spool was moved ahead of all four. (3) createaddition:biomass sits at 0.846 but festive_spool 0.547 consumes biomass. (4) createaddition:seed_oil_bucket 0.615 is listed after biomass in effect, but seed oil (create:compacting of forge:seeds) is the forge:plantoil input that every one of the eight biomass mixing recipes requires. Recipe graph preferred in all four cases. DROPPED: createaddition:accumulator - it is a valid id (model plus lang) but has ZERO recipes and its own tooltip reads "Accumulates electric charge. Deprecated and subject to removal from future releases". createaddition:modular_accumulator is the live replacement and is used instead. createaddition:creative_energy (Creative Generator) dropped as creative-only, no recipe. ALSO EXCLUDED, with reason: createaddition:digital_adapter is valid and craftable but its only recipe carries a forge:mod_loaded condition on computercraft, so it is dead in a pack without CC:Tweaked - unsafe as a chain step. createaddition:electrum_ingot is kept on the spine but carries a soft gate worth flagging to the pack author: its create:mixing recipe is wrapped in a forge:not/forge:tag_empty condition on forge:ingots/silver, so with no silver-providing mod installed electrum is uncraftable and the entire electrum_ingot / electrum_sheet / electrum_block / electrum_amulet / electrum_rod / electrum_wire / electrum_spool family becomes unobtainable. createaddition:electrum_nugget excluded per desirability (authors quest the ingot, never the nugget). The jar carries a large compat surface that produces no createaddition ids and so contributed nothing: immersiveengineering plates/wires/sticks, tconstruct alloys, mekanism enriching/infusing, ae2 charged certus, computercraft, and jeed. createaddition:liquid_burning (14 recipes) registers lava, ethanol, biofuel, biodiesel, plantoil, creosote, crude oil, diesel and gasoline as burnable liquid fuels with burn times - biofuel is flagged superheated - which is why the biomass wheel is a fuel wheel and not a decoration wheel.
